requirements.statement: The loader MUST support explicitly selected frontmatter and standard discovery and reject the removed native directive header.
acceptance: Compile equivalent current packages in both supported forms; reject the native header without executing a body.

requirements.statement: Discovery MUST enforce a 4096-byte maximum including delimiters without reading contract bodies.
acceptance: Probe exact boundary, oversized, unterminated, CRLF and invalid UTF-8 prefixes.

requirements.statement: Source loading MUST use bounded immutable bytes and verify package paths, unchanged headers and referenced digests.
acceptance: Reject traversal, symlinks, changed prefixes, changed bodies and oversized source.

requirements.statement: The compiler MUST implement the complete line grammar and reject unsupported directives or expressions.
acceptance: Run positive and negative grammar vectors for every declaration and option.

requirements.statement: Preceding triple-quoted documentation MUST attach to the next node and remain nonexecutable metadata.
acceptance: Check indentation, escapes, newline, field/rule/duty attachment, interpolation rejection and orphan literals.

requirements.statement: Types MUST preserve exact fields, bounds, enum values and accepted-fact reference kinds.
acceptance: Reject invalid bounds, duplicate values and unknown reference types.

requirements.statement: Static validation MUST reject ambiguous rules, unknown names, unmatched references and structurally unsatisfiable duties.
acceptance: Assert each documented error code with a bounded line/detail result.

requirements.statement: Compilation MUST produce deterministic normalized IR, rule/duty IDs and behavior/source digests.
acceptance: Compare full IR in independent adapters; documentation-only changes preserve only the behavior digest.

requirements.statement: Query APIs MUST retain attached documentation in full and role-specific definitions.
acceptance: Query every node category and check filtering plus metadata preservation.

requirements.statement: Untrusted malformed source MUST return bounded errors without executing code or crashing the service.
acceptance: Fuzz bounded source, escapes, invalid Unicode, huge digits and unsupported YAML constructs.

requirements.statement: Session configuration MUST bind every role to one distinct trusted principal and validate all limits and time arithmetic.
acceptance: Reject missing/extra/duplicate bindings, invalid IDs, absent policy and overflow.

requirements.statement: Wire normalization MUST reject duplicate keys, unsupported numbers, unknown fields and transport conflicts.
acceptance: Run raw JSON and transport-carrier vectors including literal escapes and nested duplicate keys.

requirements.statement: Canonical bytes and SHA-256 identities MUST match the specified integer-only UTF-8 profile.
acceptance: Compare byte vectors in at least two languages including controls and astral Unicode.

requirements.statement: Text fields MUST enforce a finite UTF-8 byte bound and any declared Unicode 16.0 extended grapheme bound independently of runtime defaults.
acceptance: Pass the pinned Unicode GraphemeBreakTest corpus and cross-runtime drift regressions; test exact multibyte byte bounds, grapheme bounds and rejected grapheme-only declarations.

requirements.statement: Admission MUST follow the specified clock, identity, envelope, duplicate, version, rule, payload, reference and quota precedence.
acceptance: Use inputs violating multiple conditions to assert the selected reason and any persisted expiry.

requirements.statement: Accepted messages MUST update facts, receipts, variables, counters, contributions, duties and state atomically in the reducer.
acceptance: Compare exact state and decision after every trace step.

requirements.statement: Exact references MUST equal the currently bound accepted ID and a permitted fact kind.
acceptance: Reject a nonexistent ID, another fact of the same kind and an obsolete rebound ID.

requirements.statement: Timed rules and events with each MUST preserve all-participant duties; grouped rules without each MUST preserve first-responder duties and independent selected obligations.
acceptance: Test all roles, selected sets, duplicate contributions, multiple timed events and first-responder behavior; reject removed due all/any grammar.

requirements.statement: Timers MUST expire at the inclusive boundary with deterministic earliest-time and priority/ID ties.
acceptance: Test just-before/equal/after, ties, late observation, clock regression and terminal idempotence.

requirements.statement: The current profile MUST have no idle timer and MUST reject inactivity-timeout and activity declarations; owed work and explicit contract/state clocks still expire, while optional accepted/transition/marked configuration remains valid but inert.
acceptance: Exercise accepted events, transitions, duplicate/rejected/read attempts without idle expiry; reject removed source forms and check timed owed-work expiry.

requirements.statement: max_entries MUST count initial/reentries and select its terminal overflow outcome deterministically.
acceptance: Exercise exact limit, overflow, self-loop and preservation of attempted-entry count.

requirements.statement: Duplicate receipt handling MUST precede terminal/version checks and preserve the original decision without another effect.
acceptance: Resend before/after completion/expiry and reject conflicting actor/payload/version under the same ID.

requirements.statement: Recipient routing and message budgets MUST be exact and unaffected by duplicate attempts; mentions is a per-message default or rule override, never a cumulative session cap.
acceptance: Check sender exclusion, deduplicated delivery, message-cap recovery, more than 200 accepted mentions, and rejected mention_budget syntax.

requirements.statement: Role views MUST expose only authored/addressed facts and relevant legal moves/duties while retaining documentation.
acceptance: Compare views of every participant and reject outsiders.

requirements.statement: Portable state/checkpoints MUST have explicit profiles, strict schemas, pinned identities and validated invariants.
acceptance: Round-trip full/redacted state and reject malformed recomputed-checksum packets.

requirements.statement: Local preflight MUST use the same semantics and a fresh authority time/version while retaining final room authority.
acceptance: Compare remote/local decisions, stale views, deadline races and fresh-process restoration.

requirements.statement: Sessionless events MUST remain separate from session state and use explicit room bindings/policy.
acceptance: Verify no session transition/counter changes and reject unauthorized/session-bearing traffic.

requirements.statement: Room event/mention windows MUST reset on aligned boundaries independently of session quotas.
acceptance: Test multi-window gaps, exact boundaries and budget exhaustion.

requirements.statement: Room receipts MUST survive quota resets and cannot be silently evicted to permit repeated effects.
acceptance: Test duplicates across windows and explicit retention-limit rejection.

requirements.statement: An authority offering durable sessionless room events MUST preserve their state and receipts across service restart and concurrent admission.
acceptance: Restart and race independent owners against the durable event authority.

requirements.statement: An authority MUST serialize decisions per scope through exclusive ownership or transactional database locking.
acceptance: Race simultaneous proposals through separate processes and assert one version order.

requirements.statement: Acceptance MUST become durable before an acknowledgement or visible resulting message is exposed.
acceptance: Crash after commit before reply and prove exactly one accepted effect/receipt.

requirements.statement: A failed commit MUST invalidate speculative state and recover only from verified durable history.
acceptance: Inject commit/snapshot failure and compare restored state and decisions.

requirements.statement: Idle and offline deadlines MUST advance without a participant request and remain absolute across restart.
acceptance: Stop before a deadline, restart after it and observe the original expired_at and durable outcome.

requirements.statement: Journal/snapshot replay MUST verify identities, history integrity and recorded decision/state agreement.
acceptance: Reject corrupted records, every corrupted snapshot and mismatched configuration/source.

requirements.statement: Storage growth MUST be bounded without dropping active work or deduplication receipts.
acceptance: Exhaust record, record-byte, database and disk capacities and verify prior commits remain recoverable.

requirements.statement: Backups/restores MUST be private, verified, consistent, atomically published and no-overwrite.
acceptance: Restore a backup containing accepted receipts and pending work; reject corrupt/aliased targets.

requirements.statement: Programs MUST declare full, partial or LLM-only coverage and qualify the claimed semantic domain.
acceptance: Exercise representative handled, delegated, ambiguous and unsuitable cases with expected semantics.

requirements.statement: The callback ABI MUST use copied JSON inputs/state and only Handled or Delegate outputs.
acceptance: Check schema, checkpoint equality, illegal result shapes and no mutation of committed host state.

requirements.statement: Incoming events MUST be confirmed against authenticated room facts and deduplicated before execution.
acceptance: Reject forged/conflicting events and repeat a completed event without code/model/effect repetition.

requirements.statement: Per-turn and ongoing delegation MUST persist the intended routing across turns and restart.
acceptance: Alternate qualified and free-form tasks and restart during ongoing takeover.

requirements.statement: Local rejection MUST prevent program publication and final room rejection MUST not commit candidate state.
acceptance: Propose wrong-turn, wrong-schema, stale-reference and stale-version outputs and inspect actual room effects.

requirements.statement: Accepted state, input completion, receipt, outbox clearing and optional snapshot MUST commit atomically.
acceptance: Fail the transaction after room acceptance, recover, and assert one reply and one state transition.

requirements.statement: Unknown effects MUST retain exact intents and use destination reconciliation before any replacement output.
acceptance: Lose acknowledgements for idempotent and non-idempotent destinations and assert the permitted retry count.

requirements.statement: Queues, retries, calls and repair counts MUST be bounded and persist across restart.
acceptance: Exhaust each budget, retry/restart and verify no reset or hot loop.

requirements.statement: Every Python callback input MUST be durably recorded before executing code.
acceptance: Observe the committed exact request at the actual execution boundary for initialization, turns and validation.

requirements.statement: Every complete bounded callback output/error MUST be recorded before staging or publishing effects.
acceptance: Inspect raw stdout/stderr/result and failure records before the first room send.

requirements.statement: Invocation identity MUST bind its program, operation, exact inputs, execution policy and purpose.
acceptance: Reject conflicting reuse of an invocation ID and isolate validation identities from live work.

requirements.statement: Recovery MUST reuse recorded results without executing code or rerunning initialization.
acceptance: Crash after output commit before staging and block all execution functions during recovery.

requirements.statement: An input without durable output MUST remain explicit unresolved work and cannot silently resample.
acceptance: Exit after input commit and fail output persistence; verify no rerun or publication on ordinary recovery.

requirements.statement: Output overflow/timeout MUST retain bounded evidence and cannot masquerade as a complete successful result.
acceptance: Emit excessive/partial output, terminate, and assert explicit incomplete failure and preserved prior state.

requirements.statement: Offline journal replay/export MUST use recorded data without code, provider, clock advancement or external effects.
acceptance: Disable execution/network interfaces while reconstructing and exporting a recorded invocation/history.

requirements.statement: Provider operations MUST use trusted host configuration and bounded durable call/result records.
acceptance: Crash and timeout before/after provider result recording; verify uncertainty and completed-result reuse.

requirements.statement: Model output MUST pass the same state, local-contract and room-admission checks as program output.
acceptance: Return malformed, illegal and semantically wrong model replies and assert the relevant hold/rejection.

requirements.statement: Late provider results MUST not mutate state or publish and duplicate concurrent operations MUST be prevented.
acceptance: Stall a provider beyond its deadline and release it after another control/turn boundary.

requirements.statement: Live provider quality and actual usage MUST be measured separately from scripted mechanism tests and saved calls.
acceptance: Run the declared semantic quality set with the pinned provider/model and record usage without secrets.

requirements.statement: Provider/model context MUST be bounded and contain only authorized public context, never credentials/private checkpoints.
acceptance: Inspect captured prompts for private markers and stress long history/output capacity.

requirements.statement: Reported provider usage MUST be counted once per durable result, and missing usage or prices MUST remain explicitly unknown.
acceptance: Recover completed calls, race response and repair results, and compare reported/unreported calls and exact integer token/cost aggregates.

requirements.statement: A declared native OpenAI binding MUST journal its prepared body, fix its authenticated TLS destination, bound requests/results and preserve uncertain outcomes without automatic resampling.
acceptance: Capture the real prepared request before dispatch; simulate refusal, incomplete output, body overflow, rate limit and uncertain HTTP failure; verify no effect or repeated call.

requirements.statement: Background repair MUST allow subsequent LLM turns while generation/validation is pending.
acceptance: Hold repair execution and complete another live turn before releasing it.

requirements.statement: Candidates MUST preserve state schema, initial state and accepted history and pass independent semantic checks.
acceptance: Reject changed schema, rewritten answers, bad pending-fault handling and insufficient validator evidence.

requirements.statement: Candidate validation MUST be isolated, journaled and incapable of dispatching effects.
acceptance: Inspect validation invocation records and deny network/filesystem/process effects during probes.

requirements.statement: Installation MUST catch up concurrent history and commit at a safe boundary with routing-epoch protection.
acceptance: Advance conversation/control during validation and prove bounded catch-up and no stale automatic resume.

requirements.statement: Interrupted repair and rollback MUST preserve accepted state, pending effects and explicit generation uncertainty.
acceptance: Restart during generation/install and roll back a compatible artifact without replaying old effects.

requirements.statement: Generated code MUST not access host secrets/journal, network, unrestricted processes or writable artifacts.
acceptance: Run real namespace/seccomp probes on the qualified release host and prove required denials.

requirements.statement: Missing isolation or exhausted callback resources MUST fail closed with bounded cleanup.
acceptance: Remove isolation capability and exercise memory, CPU, descriptors, output and wall-clock exhaustion.

requirements.statement: State/artifact/backup files MUST enforce private ownership and resist symlink/hard-link aliasing.
acceptance: Use permissive umask, wrong ownership/writable directories and aliased paths in filesystem probes.

requirements.statement: Authenticated principals and explicit permissions MUST determine actor and operation authorization.
acceptance: Test spoofed body actors, insufficient grants, wrong rooms and revoked membership.

requirements.statement: Controls MUST be action-scoped, journaled, deduplicated and unable to escalate a wake caller's grants.
acceptance: Replay/conflict controls and request unauthorized takeover, repair or resume.

requirements.statement: Release security/dependency review MUST cover the actual trusted runtime and isolated execution boundary.
acceptance: Audit pinned dependencies, input boundaries, storage/effects and documented residual trust with findings dispositions.

requirements.statement: Remote requests MUST use verified TLS with no credential-bearing redirect or remote cleartext fallback.
acceptance: Use valid/untrusted/expired/wrong-host certificates, redirects and nonloopback HTTP.

requirements.statement: Framing, request/response bytes, headers, connection count and absolute deadlines MUST be bounded.
acceptance: Test duplicate Content-Length, transfer encoding, slow TLS/headers/body, response overflow and saturation.

requirements.statement: Capability negotiation MUST pin actor, session, contract identities and durable idempotence.
acceptance: Reject mismatched/unsupported capabilities before processing agent turns.

requirements.statement: Health and observer metrics MUST distinguish readiness from liveness without exposing payloads or credentials.
acceptance: Fail recovery/storage and inspect unauthenticated/authenticated metrics/log output.

requirements.statement: Shutdown MUST drain admitted handlers before their backend resources close.
acceptance: Stop during active bounded requests and restart with pending work intact.

requirements.statement: Reconnect MUST recover durable facts/receipts rather than rely solely on notifications.
acceptance: Drop notifications/connection, replay history and prove no lost or duplicate replies.

requirements.statement: Band requests MUST preserve acting agent/user, tenant and room membership authorization.
acceptance: Exercise both HTTP surfaces, agent-owned keys, human acting contexts, malformed typed IDs, removed/blocked/unbound participants and cross-tenant access; verify exact role coverage, distinct active bindings, immutable create retries and competing rooms claiming one session ID.

requirements.statement: State, receipt and required accepted chat message MUST commit atomically under a database session lock.
acceptance: Race separate request owners and inject each transaction failure boundary, quota refusal and commit-before-reply loss; confirm one accepted state/receipt/chat record, original duplicate decisions and after-commit-only notification.

requirements.statement: Ordinary caller-supplied chat metadata MUST not fabricate an authoritative contract fact.
acceptance: Forge contract-looking metadata and verify adapter/authority rejection; submit a private canary in the proposal ID and prove it is absent from shared chat records and notifications while the expected receipt_handle is present; inspect the same records for private payload/documentation canaries and prove that only authenticated role data supplies the actual facts.

requirements.statement: Remote programs and models MUST remain outside Band and use authenticated public role data.
acceptance: Run a remote host against a real Band room; pin actor/session/source identities, inspect credentials/data/authority boundaries, drop notifications and reconcile an exact pending outbox without repeating execution.

requirements.statement: Band integration MUST preserve existing durable history, notifications and ordinary room behavior.
acceptance: Run affected native regression gates and authenticated end-to-end room delivery/reconnect checks; verify hidden advancing inbox pages, deadlines on identity/view/proposal/inbox and offline sweep, inactive/deleted rooms, terminal receipts and individual chat deletion.

requirements.statement: Releases MUST include reproducible packages, locks, entrypoints, schemas, configuration and service lifecycle files.
acceptance: Build/install in a clean environment and serve a real request through installed entrypoints.

requirements.statement: Upgrades and rollback MUST preserve receipts, pending work and compatibility with declared durable versions.
acceptance: Migrate/rollback a nonempty store with an unresolved effect and inspect exact identities afterward.

requirements.statement: Retention/archive policy MUST be explicit and cannot silently delete active work or advertised receipts.
acceptance: Exercise policy boundaries and verify archived recovery and deduplication guarantees.

requirements.statement: Operators MUST see queue/storage pressure, faults, repairs, provider use and unknown effects without secret payload logging.
acceptance: Inspect metrics/logs with synthetic secret markers and induced faults/capacity pressure.

requirements.statement: Startup MUST complete ownership, integrity, capability, artifact, expiry and isolation checks before readiness.
acceptance: Start with each prerequisite broken and observe fail-closed readiness.

requirements.statement: Lifecycle MUST terminate owned children and prevent detached workers from mutating closed/reacquired stores.
acceptance: Exercise callback/provider/repair shutdown and subsequent ownership acquisition.

requirements.statement: Backup recovery drills MUST include source/artifacts and pending as well as accepted work.
acceptance: Restore an independently verified release backup and measure recovery with no repeated effects.

requirements.statement: Production qualification MUST name and meet a bounded workload, resource envelope and recovery/latency objectives.
acceptance: Run declared concurrency/load/soak/crash tests and publish measured distributions and limits.

requirements.statement: Requirements, schemas and conformance fixtures MUST be complete, versioned, linked and validated.
acceptance: Validate IDs, links, schema instances, fixture manifests and profile coverage.

requirements.statement: Interoperability claims MUST include independent semantic assertions or a second implementation in addition to reference output.
acceptance: Run a second-language reducer/oracle and mutation-sensitive expected trace checks.

requirements.statement: Evidence MUST identify exact tested artifacts, commands, real exit codes and failed/skipped/incomplete checks.
acceptance: Verify a machine-readable release audit against produced artifacts and requirement dispositions.

requirements.statement: Generation guidance MUST preserve authority boundaries, unknown-effect handling and independent semantic quality checks.
acceptance: Generate/inspect an adapter from the specification and reject a deliberately weakened boundary.

requirements.statement: Implemented, reviewed, packaged, published, merged and deployed states MUST be reported separately.
acceptance: Audit final delivery against both selected deployment profiles without relabeling pending work.
